messages:
sam: Deploybot kicked off v2 slowpush to prod — 5% -> 20% over 30m. Quiet window till 02:00 UTC. Ops eyes on latency + 429s. tagging rollout: v2-slowpush

maria: saw a bump in 429s from EU edge around +8m into the canary. mainly /v2/generate (mobile).

kevin: which client? mobile web or native? any lib version skew?

maria: mostly Android native. user-agent shows mobile-android/3.2.1 and 3.2.2. 3.2.2 traffic heavier.

ops: throwing ops note — increase canary hold to 15% for 10m, then re-evaluate. If 5m error-rate >1% rollback to v1. Will add pin for mobile-android for 1h as safety escrow. :warning:

sam: ack. running: `/deploybot update-rollout --id v2-slowpush --hold 15% --duration 10m`

deploy-bot: action logged — updated rollout v2-slowpush: hold=15% for 10m. Added check: error_rate_threshold=1% over 5m -> auto-rollback hook enabled.

jordan: adding client pin now. command: `/deploybot pin-client --client mobile-android --version <=3.2.1 --route v1 --until 7321116200`

deploy-bot: client pin applied: mobile-android <=3.2.1 -> v1 (applies globally). Pin expires: 7321116200.

kevin: quick thought — 3.2.2 started using new header casing which the edge normalizer missed, maybe causing 429s downstream. Can we patch gateway rule instead of broad rollback?

maria: I can run a small gateway shim to casefold headers for /v2/generate on EU first. low-risk.

ops: prefer shim + pin over rollback if error surface is header-related. timeline: maria, can you put a 15m rollout for shim in staging then EU prod?

maria: will validate in staging now. test plan: simulate 3.2.2 UA and run 200 concurrent requests, verify edge 200->backend 200 mapping. If good, promote to EU prod in 15m.

sam: decision summary: hold at 15% for 10m, client pin applied for 1h, enable auto-rollback threshold, trial gateway header-casefold shim in staging -> EU prod if tests pass. Ops to escalate and rollback if error_rate stays >1% after shim.

kevin: thanks. ping me if the shim fail results look odd — I'll be ready to flip rollback. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: note: if manual rollback triggered, follow rollback playbook v2->v1 (run `/deploybot rollback --id v2-slowpush --target v1` and notify #release-war-room)

jordan: added release-notes note: "mobile clients 3.2.2 may see degraded success on /v2 endpoints; pin applied for older clients; gateway shim being tested."

sam: closing loop — watch dashboards + ops runbook. thanks all.
